events.detail: Required no-charge service APIs enabled; enabling Compute created the provider default network and default compute service account.
Authenticated billing report showed CA$0.00 current actual and forecast with no result rows; billing delay remains possible.

Initial state/WIF bootstrap started. The keyless expiry reconciliation failed because Cloud Resource Manager was disabled. No GKE cluster, VM, application disk, image registry, application secret or expiry scheduler was created.

Owner finalization verified the first state bucket and every object generation absent, federation identities deleted, and all owned runtime/guard inventories empty. The original deadline was closed, not extended.
